defs.def: almost no; almost not; almost none 几乎不；几乎没有

ex.s: Hardly had I written half a page when I felt a sharp pain in my chest
ex.t: 我刚写了半页，就感到胸口一阵剧痛

ex.s: As it has been many years since I last used one, I should hardly be surprised that there are no longer any public telephones near my house.
ex.t: 距离我上次使用电话亭已经很多年了，所以我几乎不惊讶我家附近已经没有任何公用电话了。

ex.s: I hardly have a minute to myself. ”
ex.t: “我几乎连一分钟属于自己的时间都没有。”

ex.s: I stopped the ball and kicked it hardly back to the playground.
ex.t: 我停下球，用力把它踢回操场。

ex.s: Those who tend to think back can hardly go ahead．
ex.t: B．那些倾向于回顾过去的人几乎无法前进。

ex.s: The instructor kept repeating the word, “Speed up!” “Slow down!” “Turning left!” I was so much nervous that I could hardly tell which direction was left.
ex.t: 教练不停地重复这个词： “加速！“慢点！ ”“向左转！ “我非常紧张，几乎分不清剩下哪个方向。

ex.s: He hardly let his guests say a word!
ex.t: 他几乎不让他的客人说一句话！

ex.s: He hardly ever took a day off and not once stayed home sick.
ex.t: 他几乎从未休息过一天，也没有一次因病请假在家。

ex.s: Jimmy was able to bound easily up the gentle slope, hardly noticing the weight of his spacesuit because of the Moon’s low gravity.
ex.t: 吉米能够轻松地跳上平缓的斜坡，由于月球的低重力，几乎感觉不到太空服的重量。

defs.def: （尤用于 can 或 could 之后，主要动词之前，强调做某事很难）

ex.s: I could hardly wait to 47  him.
ex.t: 我迫不及待地想要____47____见他。

ex.s: But something inside me was going to climb that mountain at all cost． I could hardly wait to try this adventure again．
ex.t: 但我内心有股力量要不惜一切代价去爬那座山。我迫不及待地想再试一次这次冒险。

ex.s: If “hard” is the opposite of “soft”, why are “hardly” and “softly” not an opposing pair?
ex.t: 如果hard是soft的反义词，为什么hardly和softly不是一对反义词？

defs.def: （表示不大可能、不合理或愚蠢）

chunks.cn: 几乎不 在任何时候
与 踢 它 几乎不
背部 能 几乎不
费用 我 能 几乎不
